brief: Two bases side by side and nothing else structural: no more bases or half bases. Add a drawer that fills the empty spot beside both of them.

requirements.requirement: Two bases side by side and no more bases or half bases

requirements.requirement: Add a drawer that fills the empty spot beside both of them
requirements.evidence: Two touching full bases create notch sites at 0,1 and 1,-1; placed notch:0#0,1#notch1 (hex-drawer-frame-notch-fm) and notch:0#1,-1#notch4 (hex-drawer-frame-notch-mf) which are the configurator's 'notch drawer' that stands in the empty cell beside two touching bases. No additional bases added.

finish.summary: Two side-by-side full bases at 0,0,0 and 1,0,0. Added notch-drawer frames in both cells adjacent to both bases (0,1 and 1,-1) using hex-drawer-frame-notch-fm/mf - these are the notch drawers that fill the empty spot beside two touching bases. Check passes with meshClash clear.

lines.label: M3 x 10 socket head screw, ISO 4762
M6 x 20 socket head screw, ISO 4762

notes: Tighten every M6 to 2 N.m: HAND TOOLS ONLY, never a cordless driver. These bolts clamp printed PETG, not metal: at the bolt's own 10.4 N.m rating the head crushes the plastic under it and the joint fails silently, looking tight while holding nothing. Snug, then a nudge. Re-check the bolts after the first few weeks: PETG relaxes under load and the clamp will have eased.
